description: Create AWS Glue Catalog infrastructure for Silver Iceberg tables
steps: Create Glue Catalog database `prediction_silver`
Configure IAM roles with Glue Catalog and S3 read/write permissions
Set up S3 path structure for Silver Iceberg data (e.g., s3://<bucket>/silver/)
Verify catalog connectivity from local dev environment

description: Integrate PyIceberg library and create Silver module structure
steps: Add PyIceberg dependency (with boto3/s3fs/glue extras) to pyproject.toml
Create `src/prediction_data/silver/__init__.py` module structure
Create `src/prediction_data/silver/catalog.py` with Glue catalog connection factory
Implement catalog connection error handling and retries
Configure catalog properties (warehouse location, catalog type=glue)

description: Create CLI command to initialize all Silver Iceberg tables
steps: Create CLI command `prediction-data silver init-tables`
Implement table creation for all 6 Silver tables (polymarket trades/markets/events, kalshi trades/markets/events)
Configure table properties: Parquet format, ZSTD compression, 128-512MB target file size, copy-on-write
Configure partition spec: `days(event_ts)`
Configure sort order: `platform_market_id`, `event_ts`
Add dry-run mode for table creation
Verify tables appear in Glue Catalog

description: Unit and integration tests for Iceberg foundation
steps: Create `tests/test_silver_catalog.py` with catalog connection tests
Test table creation idempotency (create-if-not-exists)
Test schema round-trip (create table, read schema, verify)
Integration test: create table and verify in Glue Catalog
